asset.name: Polygon

score_rationales.institutional: POL has mid-tier institutional infrastructure — 21Shares physically-backed ETP, Bitwise accredited-investor fund, Grayscale spot ETF filing, CME-listed futures via Kraken, custody at BitGo/Anchorage/AMINA Bank, and meaningful TradFi pilots (Franklin Templeton tokenized fund, Visa stablecoin settlement on Polygon) — but lacks a US spot ETF approval, a dedicated CME native contract, and significant corporate treasury adoption, keeping it well behind BTC/ETH in institutional depth.
score_rationales.regulatory: POL (formerly MATIC) was explicitly named as an unregistered security in the SEC's 2023 Coinbase and Binance complaints, creating meaningful US jurisdictional overhang that the MATIC→POL rebrand did not resolve; no ETF applications exist and institutional adoption is concentrated in Polygon's enterprise infrastructure (Disney, Reddit, Starbucks) rather than the token itself, providing indirect but not direct regulatory validation.
